# Harmony
Server IP: play.harmony.pm

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/V7XZa6p

Opened in 2016, Harmony is one of the longest running Pokemon Minecraft servers out there. Come join us and our friendly community for a fresh take on a Cobblemon collection experience!

### Join now to obtain the Premium Battlepass for free!
